info.title: gocast API
info.description:
The shiny new gocast API!
This API is designed to be a user-friendly and easy-to-use interface for third party services.
It provides access to all non-administrative features of the GoCast platform.
Make sure to log in to TUM-Live before making any requests that need authentication via these docs.

tags.name: MetaService
tags.description: Endpoints that describe the deployment rather than any resource in it.

tags.name: UserService
tags.description:
The signed-in user's own account, and the endpoints the login page needs
before anyone is signed in.

tags.name: CourseService
tags.description: Courses and the caller's relationship to them.

tags.name: StreamService
tags.description:
Individual streams and everything scoped to one: sections, subtitles,
thumbnails, watch progress and bookmarks.

tags.name: AdminService
tags.description:
Server administration: everything belonging to no particular course.

One service rather than one per resource, because runner/*.proto shares this proto
package and is linked into the same binary — `RunnerService` is already taken there,
and a collision only shows up as a panic at boot.

It groups endpoints, not permissions: policies are per method in services.go, and
the account pages need PermManageUsers rather than PermAdministerServer.

get.description: Retrieves one page of the server-wide audit log -- course and stream changes, camera moves, and warnings or errors the backend surfaced itself -- newest first. Requires the server.administer permission.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Defaults to 10 server-side when omitted or zero, matching the page size the old
admin page used.

post.description: Creates a course and its streams for each selected course, then emails its main contact an activation (or opt-out) link. A failure importing one course does not stop the others; the response reports each outcome. Requires the server.administer permission.

post.summary: Search the TUMonline room schedule for courses.
post.description: Fetches the department's room schedule from TUMonline for the given date range, groups it by course and enriches each with its contacts and language. Requires the server.administer permission.

get.summary: List every info page for administration.
get.description: Retrieves every info page with its raw content, for editing. Requires the server.administer permission.

post.description: Creates a page reachable at /{slug} once created, without a redeploy. The slug must be unique. Requires the server.administer permission.

delete.description: Deletes an info page; its route stops resolving immediately. Requires the server.administer permission.

patch.description: Replaces an info page's slug, title and content. Requires the server.administer permission.

get.description: Returns application details and key status, never API keys. Requires the server.administer permission.

post.description: Registers an application with its return URL and returns a new API key. Requires the server.administer permission.

delete.description: Invalidates the key without deleting the application. Requires the server.administer permission.

post.description: Returns a new key and invalidates the old one. Requires the server.administer permission.

get.summary: List every lecture hall for administration.
get.description: Retrieves every lecture hall with its stream sources. Requires the server.administer permission.

post.description: Creates a lecture hall the scheduler can assign lectures to. Requires the server.administer permission.

delete.description: Deletes a lecture hall; its streams keep playing but lose the hall association. Requires the server.administer permission.

patch.description: Replaces a lecture hall's name, stream protocol and stream sources. Requires the server.administer permission.

post.summary: Refresh a lecture hall's camera presets.
post.description: Fetches the presets configured on the hall's camera and replaces the stored list with them. Requires the server.administer permission.

post.summary: Mark a camera preset the hall's default.
post.description: Marks one preset default for the hall and unsets the others. The default is what a stream's recording starts pointed at. Requires the server.administer permission.

post.summary: Take a new preview snapshot of a camera preset.
post.description: Moves the camera to the preset, waits for it to arrive, and photographs it. Requires the server.administer permission.

get.summary: List the jobs the scheduler knows by name.
get.description: Retrieves the names of every registered cron job, for triggering one manually. Requires the server.administer permission.

post.description: Executes a registered job immediately, without waiting for its schedule. Requires the server.administer permission.

get.description: Retrieves every email that has exhausted its retries or is still failing, with its body and error history. Requires the server.administer permission.

delete.description: Deletes a failed email; it is not retried afterwards. Requires the server.administer permission.

post.description: Starts a background job that requests a fresh thumbnail for every VoD file. A run already in progress is left alone rather than started twice. Requires the server.administer permission.

get.description: Reports whether a thumbnail regeneration run is in progress and how far it has gotten. Requires the server.administer permission.
Retrieves every recorded transcoding failure, worker and log included. Requires the server.administer permission.

delete.description: Deletes a recorded transcoding failure. It does not retry the transcode. Requires the server.administer permission.

get.summary: List every user notification for administration.
get.description: Retrieves every notification ever broadcast to users, newest first. Requires the server.administer permission.

post.description: Creates a notification shown to users matching its target group. Requires the server.administer permission.

delete.description: Deletes a notification; it stops showing to users immediately. Requires the server.administer permission.

get.description: Retrieves every registered runner with its current liveness and workload. Requires the server.administer permission.

delete.description: Removes a runner registration. A runner that is still running re-registers on its next heartbeat. Requires the server.administer permission.

get.summary: List every server notification for administration.
get.description: Retrieves every server notification, past, active and future, with its id. Requires the server.administer permission.

post.description: Creates a banner shown site-wide between start and expires. Requires the server.administer permission.

delete.description: Deletes a server notification; it stops showing immediately. Requires the server.administer permission.

patch.description: Replaces a server notification's text, severity and active window. Requires the server.administer permission.

get.description: Retrieves the quick counters and the charted activity for the whole deployment, i.e. the same data api/statistics.go serves a course for, with courseID 0. Requires the server.administer permission.
Bundles the same data getServerStats renders as a single downloadable file, as JSON or CSV. Requires the server.administer permission.
Retrieves every issued token's owner, scope and usage -- never the secret itself, which is shown only once, at creation. Requires the users.manage permission.

post.description: Creates a token for self-streaming or admin API access and returns its secret. The secret is returned only in this response and cannot be retrieved again. Requires the users.manage permission.

delete.description: Deletes a token; it stops authenticating immediately. Requires the users.manage permission.

get.description: Retrieves every account holding a staff role, with contact details unmasked. Requires the users.manage permission.

post.description: Creates an account with the lecturer role and emails an invitation to set a password. Requires the users.manage permission.

get.description: Searches every account by name, email or login. Contact details come back masked. The query must be at least three characters unless a role is given. Requires the users.manage permission.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: At least three characters unless role is set, so an empty box lists nobody.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Restricts the search to one role. Absent means every role.

delete.description: Deletes an account. Administrators cannot be deleted. Requires the users.manage permission.

patch.description: Sets the role of an account. Requires the users.manage permission.

get.description: Retrieves every registered worker with its current liveness, workload and VM stats, plus the token new workers authenticate with. Requires the server.administer permission.

delete.description: Removes a worker registration. A worker that is still running re-registers on its next heartbeat. Requires the server.administer permission.

get.description: Retrieves bookmarks by stream ID.

post.description: Adds a new bookmark.

get.description: Returns the deployment's branding, version and links. Answers before anyone has signed in, because the frontend needs it to render its shell.
Retrieves the public courses for a given semester.

post.description: Creates a course visible to signed-in users, with VoDs on and downloads and chat off, and makes the caller its administrator. Requires the lecture permission. Answers 409 if the semester already has a course with the slug.

get.summary: List the courses the caller administers.
get.description: Every semester's; every course for someone who administers them all. Requires the lecture permission.
Retrieves the enrolled courses for a user for a given semester.

get.summary: Get currently live courses with streams.
get.description: Retrieves the currently live courses with their streams.
Retrieves the pinned courses for a user.

delete.summary: Delete a course and its lectures.

get.description: What the course's settings tab shows and edits. Requires administering the course.
Those granted the course explicitly; neither its owner nor the server's administrators are listed unless they were. Requires administering the course.

post.summary: Make a user an administrator of a course.
post.description: A student or external participant is promoted to lecturer, as v1 did. Requires administering the course.

get.summary: Find a user to make an administrator of a course.
get.description: Matches name, login and email; at least three letters or digits. At most ten results. Requires administering the course.

delete.summary: Remove an administrator from a course.
delete.description: Answers 400 for the course's last administrator and 404 for someone who is not one. Requires administering the course.

post.summary: Copy a course into another semester.
post.description: Copies the course's settings, every one of its lectures and its administrators into a new course in the given semester. Requires administering the course. Answers 409 if that semester already has a course with the slug.

get.summary: List the course's source settings per lecture hall.
get.description: One entry per hall the course has a lecture in: which sources to stream and which camera preset to use. Requires administering the course.

put.summary: Replace the course's source settings per lecture hall.
put.description: Replaces every hall's settings with the ones sent; a hall left out goes back to the defaults. Requires administering the course.

get.summary: List a course's lectures for its administrators.
get.description: Every lecture of the course, newest first, with what managing it needs: times, hall, series, stream key, state, files, sections and transcoding progress. Requires administering the course.

get.summary: List the external participants invited to a course.
get.description: Accounts without a TUM login that were invited by email. Requires administering the course.

post.summary: Invite external participants to a course by email.
post.description: An address without an account gets one and an email to set its password; an existing account is enrolled and notified. At most 200 per call. Requires administering the course.

get.description: Checks if the user has pinned the course.

post.description: Pins or unpins a course for the user.

patch.description: Sets the fields that are present and leaves the rest. Requires administering the course.

get.description: Returns the quick counters and charted viewer activity of one course. Requires administering the course.
Bundles the same data getCourseStats returns as a single downloadable file, as JSON or CSV. Requires administering the course.

post.summary: Delete some of a course's lectures.
post.description: Deletes nothing unless every lecture named is one of the course's. Requires administering the course.

patch.summary: Change one of a course's lectures.
patch.description: Sets the fields that are present and leaves the rest: name, description, start and end (both or neither, end after start), lecture hall (0 for none), chat and visibility. The lecture must be one of the course's. Requires administering the course. Unlike v1, viewers watching at the time are not told; they see the change on reload.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: Must be one of the course's lectures; anything else answers as missing.

post.summary: Copy or move a lecture to another course.
post.description: Creates a copy of the lecture in the target course and, with move, then deletes the original. Requires administering both courses; a target the caller does not administer answers 404, as a missing one does.

post.summary: Switch a live stream's camera to a preset.
post.description: Moves the camera of the stream's lecture hall to the preset and returns once it has had time to arrive. The stream must be live and the preset must belong to its lecture hall. Requires administering the course.

delete.summary: Delete a lecture and the rest of its series.
delete.description: Deletes every lecture of the course sharing the lecture's series. Answers 400 for a lecture in no series. Requires administering the course.

patch.summary: Change every lecture of a lecture's series.
patch.description: Sets the fields that are present on every lecture of the course sharing the lecture's series, the lecture included. Answers 400 for a lecture in no series. Requires administering the course.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: Any lecture of the series; must be one of the course's.

put.summary: Move a lecture and its whole series to a new time of day.
put.description: Sets the lecture's start and end, then gives every other lecture of the course in its series the same time of day and duration, each on its own date. Answers 400 for a lecture in no series. Requires administering the course.

get.description: Returns the viewer counters and charted activity of one of the course's lectures. Requires administering the course.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: Must be one of the course's lectures; anything else answers as missing.

get.description: Retrieves a course by its slug, year, and term.
Retrieves every info page's slug and title, without its content. Public, so a client can find pages an administrator has added without a redeploy.
Returns an info page - the privacy policy, imprint, about page, or any further page an administrator has added - as sanitised HTML. Public: these are pages a visitor reads before deciding to sign in.
Reports whether single sign-on is configured, so that a login page knows which options to offer. Requires no authentication.
Retrieves notifications for the current user.

get.summary: Get watch progress for a batch of streams.
get.description: Retrieves all watch progresses for the current user.

patch.description: Updates the watch progress of a stream for the current user.

get.description: Returns the lectures overlapping [from, to) -- at most 100 days -- of the courses the caller administers, optionally only in some lecture halls. Requires the lecture permission.

parameters.name: lectureHallIds
parameters.description:
Only lectures in these halls; 0 stands for lectures in none. Ignored when
all_lecture_halls is set.

get.summary: List the lecture halls the schedule can be filtered by.
get.description: Names and IDs only; listLectureHallsAdmin has the rest. Requires the lecture permission.
Retrieves all available semesters and the current semester.
Retrieves current server notifications.
If this endpoint does not return 200, the API is experiencing a catastrophic outage.

get.summary: Get stream and course by course slug and stream ID.
get.description: Retrieves a stream and its course by its stream ID.

get.summary: Get stream playlist by course slug and stream ID.
get.description: Retrieves the playlist for a stream including watch progress.

get.summary: Get video sections by course slug and stream ID.
get.description: Retrieves the video sections for a stream.

get.summary: Get subtitles by course slug, stream ID, and language.
get.description: Retrieves the subtitles for a stream in a specific language.

get.summary: Get thumbs by course slug, stream ID, and optional thumb type.
get.description: Retrieves the thumbs for a stream.
Searches the courses prefetched from TUMOnline, to fill in a new course. Requires the lecture permission. Answers 503 when the search backend is unavailable.
Exports the current user's data.
Retrieves the current user.

post.description: Resets the user password.

targetCourseId.description: Must also be administered by the caller.

move.description: Deletes the original once the copy exists.

CourseServiceupdateCourseSettingsBody.description: The settings v1's course settings form edited.

start.description: Both or neither; end must be after start.

lectureHallId.description: 0 moves the lecture out of any hall (self-streamed).

private.description: Withholds the lecture from everyone but the course's administrators.

lectureHallId.description: 0 moves the series out of any hall.

start.description:
The lecture's own new times; the rest of the series takes their time of day
and duration. End must be after start.

contentType.description: The HTTP Content-Type header value specifying the content type of the body.

data.description: The HTTP request/response body as raw binary.

extensions.description:
Application specific response metadata. Must be set in the first response
for streaming APIs.

title.description: Empty when the notification has no title.

target.description:
Reuses NotificationTarget's values, but model.NotificationTarget numbers its
targets from 1, not 0, so this is a plain uint32 rather than the enum -- casting
model.NotificationTarget straight into NotificationTarget would shift every value
down by one (see apiv2/helpers/parser.go's ParseNotificationToProto, which already
does this for the read side; nothing there reads the shifted field back out, so it
has gone unnoticed).

protobufAdminNotification.description:
AdminNotification is a broadcast notification as an administrator manages it.
Distinct from UserGroupNotification above, which is what a recipient is shown:
this carries an id, so a specific entry can be deleted. Named with the Admin
prefix because a bare "Notification" already exists in runner/notifications.proto,
registered under the same "protobuf" package -- reusing the name panics the
process at startup with a proto registry name conflict.

@type.description:
Identifies the type of the serialized Protobuf message with a URI reference
consisting of a prefix ending in a slash and the fully-qualified type name.

Example: type.googleapis.com/google.protobuf.StringValue

This string must contain at least one `/` character, and the content after
the last `/` must be the fully-qualified name of the type in canonical
form, without a leading dot. Do not write a scheme on these URI references
so that clients do not attempt to contact them.

The prefix is arbitrary and Protobuf implementations are expected to
simply strip off everything up to and including the last `/` to identify
the type. `type.googleapis.com/` is a common default prefix that some
legacy implementations require. This prefix does not indicate the origin of
the type, and URIs containing it are not expected to respond to any
requests.

All type URL strings must be legal URI references with the additional
restriction (for the text format) that the content of the reference
must consist only of alphanumeric characters, percent-encoded escapes, and
characters in the following set (not including the outer backticks):
`/-.~_!$&()*+,;=`. Despite our allowing percent encodings, implementations
should not unescape them to prevent confusion with existing parsers. For
example, `type.googleapis.com%2FFoo` should be rejected.

In the original design of `Any`, the possibility of launching a type
resolution service at these type URLs was considered but Protobuf never
implemented one and considers contacting these URLs to be problematic and
a potential security issue. Do not attempt to contact type URLs.

protobufAny.description:
`Any` contains an arbitrary serialized protocol buffer message along with a
URL that describes the type of the serialized message.

In its binary encoding, an `Any` is an ordinary message; but in other wire
forms like JSON, it has a special encoding. The format of the type URL is
described on the `type_url` field.

Protobuf APIs provide utilities to interact with `Any` values:

- A 'pack' operation accepts a message and constructs a generic `Any` wrapper
  around it.
- An 'unpack' operation reads the content of an `Any` message, either into an
  existing message or a new one. Unpack operations must check the type of the
  value they unpack against the declared `type_url`.
- An 'is' operation decides whether an `Any` contains a message of the given
  type, i.e. whether it can 'unpack' that type.

The JSON format representation of an `Any` follows one of these cases:

- For types without special-cased JSON encodings, the JSON format
  representation of the `Any` is the same as that of the message, with an
  additional `@type` field which contains the type URL.
- For types with special-cased JSON encodings (typically called 'well-known'
  types, listed in https://protobuf.dev/programming-guides/json/#any), the
  JSON format representation has a key `@type` which contains the type URL
  and a key `value` which contains the JSON-serialized value.

The text format representation of an `Any` is like a message with one field
whose name is the type URL in brackets. For example, an `Any` containing a
`foo.Bar` message may be written `[type.googleapis.com/foo.Bar] { a: 2 }`.

type.description:
The audit kind, already rendered to text by model.AuditType.String() -- "Course
Created", "Camera Moved", etc. -- so the client needs no copy of that mapping.

userId.description: 0 when the audit was made by the system rather than a signed-in user.

userName.description: "- System -" when there is no user, matching model.User.GetLoginString().

protobufAuditEntry.description: AuditEntry is one row of the server-wide audit log.

protobufBranding.description: Branding is the deployment's own name for itself, configured in branding.yaml.

presetId.description:
The camera's own numbering, not a database id -- this is what SetPreset on the
camera takes.

image.description:
Filename under the static directory, empty until a snapshot has been taken.
Rendered as /public/{image}.

protobufCameraPresetAdmin.description:
CameraPresetAdmin is a camera preset as an administrator manages it: named
"*Admin" for the same reason as LectureHallAdmin -- CameraPreset above is the
trimmed, viewer-facing shape.

numErrors.description: Lectures and administrators that could not be copied; the course itself was.

streamId.description: The copy's ID, a new one even on a move.

lastRecording.description: The most recent recorded lecture, absent when the course has none.

nextLecture.description: The next lecture that has not ended yet, absent when the course has none.

visibility.description:
One of "public", "loggedin", "enrolled" or "hidden". Listings that reach the
caller are already filtered by it; it is here so the page can mark a hidden
course as such for the administrators who do see it.

pinned.description: Whether the calling user has pinned this course. False for anonymous callers.

isAdmin.description:
Whether the calling user administers this course, as opposed to being a global
admin. Drives the per-course admin link.

vodChatEnabled.description: Read-only: nothing has ever set it, so no page offers it.

userId.description: The course's owner; administrators are listed by listCourseAdmins.

protobufCourseAdmin.description: A course as its administrators see and edit it.

protobufCourseAdminSummary.description: A course in the administration sidebar.

login.description: The email address, or the TUM login without one.

protobufCourseAdminUser.description: An account as the course page shows it to the course's administrators.

protobufCourseImportContact.description:
CourseImportContact is one person TUMonline lists against the course, with the main
contact flagged: importCourseImportCourses only emails whoever has main_contact set.

language.description: "de" or "en", or empty when TUMonline reported neither.

protobufCourseImportCourse.description:
CourseImportCourse is one course as found in the TUMonline schedule, round-tripped
through the administrator's review before being created. slug and import are
editable client-side between the search and the import call.

comment.description:
Set by TUMonline for a room change or similar; shown so an administrator can spot
an event that needs a closer look before importing it.

eventId.description: TUMonline's event id, kept so the created stream can be traced back to it.

import.description:
Whether this event is included; an administrator may deselect single lectures
(e.g. one already covered by a room the department switched away from).

protobufCourseImportEvent.description:
CourseImportEvent is one room booking TUMonline reports for a course, on its way to
becoming a model.Stream.

optIn.description:
Opt in: a lecturer must activate streaming. Opt out: it starts on unless they
decline. Governs which link the invitation email sends.

protobufCourseImportResult.description:
CourseImportResult reports one course's outcome, so a failure importing one course
(a duplicate slug, an LDAP lookup miss) is visible without hiding the successes
that happened alongside it.

departmentId.description:
The TUMonline organisation unit id. The client offers presets for the usual
departments (Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Physics) and a
free-form field for any other; the server treats every id alike.

accountCreated.description: False when the address already had an account, which was enrolled instead.

lectureHallId.description: 0 and empty for a lecture in no hall (self-streamed).

seriesIdentifier.description: Shared by the lectures created together as a series; empty for a lone lecture.

streamKey.description: The secret a self-streaming lecturer puts in the ingest URL.

vodVersions.description: The recorded versions there are: any of COMB, PRES and CAM.

durationSeconds.description: The recording's length in seconds, 0 when not known.

protobufCourseLectureAdmin.description:
CourseLectureAdmin is a lecture as its course's administrators manage it. Unlike
Stream, it carries the stream key and no signed playlist URLs.

presetId.description: The preset's number on the hall's camera.

selectedPresetId.description: 0 when the course chose none, and the hall's default preset applies.

protobufCourseLectureHallSetting.description: A course's settings for one lecture hall it has lectures in.

selectedPresetId.description: One of the hall's presets, or 0 for its default.

accountSetUp.description: Whether they have set a password yet.

protobufCourseSourceMode.description: Which sources a course's lectures in a hall stream; model.SourceMode.

numLectures.description: Streams of the course that are recorded or currently live (model.Course.NumStreams).

partialHistory.description:
Set for courses from 2022 or earlier, which ran partly before viewing data was
collected (from 28 June 2021), so their numbers undercount.

protobufCourseStatsResponse.description:
The course page's counterpart of ServerStatsResponse; the series are the same, each
counted over this course alone.

slug.description: Unique within the semester; letters, digits, '-' and '_'.

term.description: "W" or "S". A winter semester starts in `year`.

tumOnlineId.description: TUMOnline's ID for the course, when it was picked from searchTumOnlineCourses.

apiKey.description: Only returned on creation; the stored hash cannot recover the key.

scope.description:
"admin" or "lecturer". An admin-scoped token additionally requires the caller
to hold users.manage, which every caller of this RPC already does.

versionTag.description: versionTag is the build's version, or "development" for an unversioned build.

wikiUrl.description: wikiUrl and canonicalUrl are empty when the deployment has not configured them.

isFreshInstallation.description:
isFreshInstallation reports that the database holds no users yet, so the
frontend can offer to create the first account instead of a login form.

name.description: name echoes the requested route name.

content.description: Rendered from Markdown and sanitised server-side; the client must not do it again.

useSaml.description:
Whether an identity provider is configured. When false, only the username and
password form applies.

idpName.description: Display name of the identity provider, shown on its sign-in button.

idpColor.description: Brand colour for that button, as a CSS colour. May be empty.

slug.description:
The page's route and API key. Unique; a client should treat changing it as
renaming the page's URL, not merely relabeling it.

name.description:
The editable display title, shown to administrators managing the page. Not
rendered on the page itself, which opens with its own Markdown heading.

protobufInfoPage.description: InfoPage is a page as an administrator edits it, with its raw, unrendered content.

protobufInfoPageSummary.description: InfoPageSummary is what a visitor is told exists, before asking for one by slug.

type.description: model.FileType: 2 = attachment, the thumbnail kinds above that.

externalUrl.description:
Where the room is, on whatever campus map the deployment points at. The live
lecture badge links to it.

name.description: As the hall is named in SMP, e.g. room_00_13_009A -- not a free-form label.

cameraIp.description:
IP of the physical Axis camera itself (not the SMP address above). Empty for
halls with no camera, e.g. VMP backed ones.

pwrCtrlIp.description: Drives the red live light through an Anel PWR-Ctrl. Empty when there is none.

cameraPresets.description:
Empty until refreshLectureHallPresetsAdmin has fetched them at least once. Only
ever populated for a hall with camera_ip set.

protobufLectureHallAdmin.description:
LectureHallAdmin is a lecture hall as an administrator configures it: the stream
sources the worker/runner pulls from plus the optional hardware addresses. Distinct
from LectureHall (LECTURE_HALL_MESSAGE above), which is the trimmed shape shown to
viewers.

numStudents.description: Enrolled in the course; a lecture has no enrolment of its own.

maxLiveViews.description: The most viewers the lecture had at once while it was live.

liveViewers.description: Concurrent viewers through the live lecture, by time of day.

weekdays.description: VoD views by day of week.

partialHistory.description:
Set for lectures from 2021 or earlier, which can predate the viewing data
(collected from 28 June 2021), so their numbers undercount.

rtmpProxyUrl.description:
Where a lecturer-scoped token points a streaming client, e.g. OBS's "Server"
field. Bundled here rather than in GetFrontendConfigResponse: nothing but this
page needs it, and it is meaningless without a token to go with it.

workerToken.description:
The token a new worker authenticates its gRPC registration with. Configuration,
not a per-caller secret -- server.administer already gates the whole page.

lastTry.description: RFC 3339, or empty when no attempt has been made yet.

protobufMaintenanceEmailFailure.description: MaintenanceEmailFailure restates model.Email for a message that never sent.

protobufMaintenanceThumbnailStatus.description:
MaintenanceThumbnailStatus reports the state of the background regeneration job.
progress is meaningless once running is false; a finished run resets it to zero
rather than leaving it at 1, so a stale tab does not read a fresh run as complete.

friendlyTime.description: Formatted server-side (02.01.2006 15:04) so the page needs no locale logic.

protobufMaintenanceTranscodingFailure.description: MaintenanceTranscodingFailure restates model.TranscodingFailure for the admin page.

protobufNotificationTarget.description:
The user group a notification is shown to. The numbers deliberately match
model.NotificationTarget, which starts at 1, so the two cannot drift; proto3 needs
a zero value, and an unset target is not "everyone" but a bug, so it gets its own.

apiKey.description: Only returned by this rotation; replaces the previous key immediately.

hostname.description: Runners are keyed by hostname; there is no numeric id.

alive.description:
Derived from last_seen: dead after five seconds without a heartbeat. Sent
computed so a client cannot disagree with the scheduler.

jobCount.description: Jobs currently running, as of the last heartbeat.

draining.description: draining means the runner is shutting down and is being given no further jobs.

lectureHallId.description: 0 and empty for a lecture in no hall (self-streamed).

protobufServerNotificationAdmin.description:
ServerNotificationAdmin is a server notification as an administrator manages it,
carrying the id ServerNotification (the public read model above) omits.

protobufServerStatsDataPoint.description:
ServerStatsDataPoint is a single point of a chart, matching dao.Stat: a label and
its value, ready to plot without further lookup.

numLectures.description:
Streams that are recorded or currently live, across every course. Matches
model.Course.NumStreams(), which the old page called with courseID 0.

activityLive.description: Weekly peak concurrent live viewers, summed across courses.

activityVod.description: Weekly VoD views, summed across courses.

hourly.description: VoD views by hour of day.

weekdays.description: VoD views by day of week.

protobufServerStatsSeries.description:
ServerStatsSeries is one of the page's charts: a label for the dataset plus its
points, in the order they should be plotted.

isPubliclyVisible.description:
False for a private lecture. Only a course administrator is ever sent one, so
this marks the lectures that the rest of the course cannot see.

userName.description:
The account it authenticates as. Mirrors how the account is shown elsewhere:
the email when there is one, name and LRZ id otherwise.

protobufToken.description:
Token is an issued API token as the administration page lists it: who holds it,
what it can do and when it was last used -- never the secret itself. The secret
exists only in the response to createToken, once, and nowhere else.

protobufTokenSecret.description:
TokenSecret carries a freshly created token's value. It is deliberately its own
message, distinct from Token, so no future field added to Token can leak a secret
into the listing by accident.

permissions.description:
What this user may do, as model/permissions.go spells it, so a client need not
know which role holds what. Not a substitute for the server's own checks.

protobufUserSettingType.description:
UserSettingType identifies a single user preference.

The values are model.UserSettingType - 1 (see apiv2/helpers/parser.go), so this
enum has to stay aligned with the constants in model/user.go. Values were
previously unnamed beyond CUSTOM_PLAYBACK_SPEEDS and travelled as bare numbers.

 - CUSTOM_PLAYBACK_SPEEDS: The per-speed enabled flags, stored as a JSON array.
 - USER_DEFINED_SPEEDS: Speeds the user added themselves, stored as a JSON array.
 - DEFAULT_MODE: Mirrors model.defaultMode, which is no longer used. Present only to keep the
numbering aligned with model.UserSettingType.

email.description: Masked on the endpoints that say so; a property of the endpoint, not the message.

protobufUserSummary.description:
UserSummary is an account as the administration pages list it: who they are and
what they may do, without the courses, settings and bookmarks that make up User.

alive.description:
Derived from last_seen: dead after six minutes without a heartbeat. Sent
computed so a client cannot disagree with the scheduler.

workload.description:
How much the worker has to do: +1 per silence detection job, +2 per converting
job, +3 per streaming job.

status.description: The jobs currently running, as a comma-separated summary the worker sends itself.

cpu.description: VM stats, self-reported by the worker; empty until it has sent a heartbeat.

protobufWorker.description:
Worker is the older, pre-runner equivalent: it also transcodes, but is keyed by a
self-generated UUID rather than hostname and carries VM stats the runner does not.
